say.111521: one hundred eleven thousand, five hundred twenty-one

scenes.name: THE GROUND
lines: Chapter two averaged over infinitely many zeros. What can a finite height, or one single zero, really give?
第二章在无穷多枚零点上取平均。那么有限的高度、单独一枚零点，究竟能给出什么？
First, the ground: RH and Dirichlet GRH now have an external Lean proof, by Levent Alpöge.
先看地基：RH 与狄利克雷 GRH 如今有了 Levent Alpöge 的外部 Lean 证明。
It is not frozen in the pinned library, so it never wears green.
它尚未冻结进所钉的库，所以从不佩戴绿色徽章。
It reaches only zeta and Dirichlet L functions, says nothing about physics, and leaves Grand RH open.
它只管 ζ 函数与狄利克雷 L 函数，不对物理说任何话；全广义黎曼猜想仍是开放问题。

scenes.name: LINE INTO CIRCLE
lines: Inside the pinned library, Lean restates the hypothesis twice.
在所钉的库内部，Lean 把这条猜想改写了两次。
First as a circle: the Cayley map lands on the unit circle exactly when the real part is one half.
第一次改写成圆：凯莱映射落在单位圆上，当且仅当实部是二分之一。
So RH says every nontrivial zero lands on the circle.
于是 RH 说：每一枚非平凡零点都落在圆上。
Then as a gap: RH holds exactly when, for every c below one forty-eighth, the prime remainder ends up c log squared below M root x.
第二次改写成差额：RH 成立，当且仅当对每个 c < 1/48，曼戈尔特余项最终比 M√x 低出 c(log x)²。

scenes.name: PHASES FALL SHORT
lines: Give each zero height gamma a harmonic weight, and add their phases at time t.
给每个零点高度 γ 一个调和权，再把它们在时刻 t 的相位加起来。
The weighted sum Z reaches length one only if every phase lines up.
加权和 Z 的长度只有在所有相位重新对齐时才能达到 1。
Under RH, Lean bounds the shortfall: near one over T, by a constant over a power of log T.
在 RH 前提下，Lean 给亏损定下界：在 1/T 附近，下界是常数除以 log T 的幂。
Out to log T, given a Landau envelope, it is at least one over 32 log T.
一直到 log T，在兰道包络的前提下，亏损至少是 1/(32 log T)。

scenes.name: ONE OVER ROOT PI
lines: That envelope comes from a Landau contour, a rectangle around the zeros.
这个包络来自兰道围道：一个圈住零点的矩形。
Lean bounds its left and right edges with explicit constants, and those bounds need no RH.
Lean 用显式常数界住它的左右两条竖边，这两条界不需要 RH。
With the top edge they give the envelope; that step is argued, not cited.
接上顶边就得到包络；这一步只是论证，未作引用。
Stitch the windows together, and Lean checks that the scaled near-collision count tends to one over root pi.
把各时间窗拼起来，Lean 检验：近碰撞的归一化计数趋于 1/√π。

scenes.name: ZERO 11431
lines: Now drop to one window: zero 11431, and nine neighbours on each side.
现在落到一个窗口：第 11431 枚零点，左右各九枚邻居。
Among three thousand centres, it sits nearest a midpoint of two neighbours: within two millionths.
在三千个中心里，它最贴近两枚邻居的中点：误差在百万分之二以内。
The runner-up is 35.6 times worse, and this extra pair carries under a quarter of the fourth moment.
次优者差了 35.6 倍；这组额外配对只占四阶矩不到四分之一。
At resolution one thousandth, it first shows up at radius 111521. These are certificates, not theorems.
分辨率取千分之一，它在半径 111521 处首次显现。这些是证书，不是定理。

scenes.name: THREE WINDOWS
lines: Later volumes ask one zero to pass three windows: light modes, strong coupling, curvature.
后面几卷要求单枚零点同时通过三扇窗：轻模、强耦合、曲率。
With the cut fixed at nine, zero 8359 passes all three first.
分界固定为 9 时，第 8359 枚最先三窗全通。
Switch to the shell's own site-variance cut, and zero 8236 gets in first.
换成球壳自身的站点方差分界，第 8236 枚抢先过关。
But field table, mass unit and cut are chosen inputs. A window hit is not a prediction.
但场表、质量标尺与分界都是选定的输入。命中窗口不是预言。

scenes.name: THE HONEST GAP
lines: Here is the gap. Every Lean bound here averages over all zeros up to T.
缺口就在这里：这里每一条 Lean 界，都是截至高度 T 的全体零点平均。
The shell reads one zero, or a handful. No comparison theorem bridges the two yet.
球壳读取的却是一枚零点、或寥寥几枚。连接两者的比较定理至今还没有。
And 11431's sharpness is local: higher up, almost every centre beats it. Averages are welded; selection is open.
第 11431 枚的锐度只是局部：更高处几乎每个中心都胜过它。平均已焊死，选点仍开放。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Omega Unification, chapter three.
《OMEGA 统一》· 第三章
